page.notes: Long s was rendered as plain s throughout (printed as f in the scan). Uncertain readings: "ii" after "nega-" on the second line of the paragraph beginning "Sententia" (marked [?]); "cuiuium" after "efficí-" (marked [?], possibly a misprint for efficientium). "Lamia" and "qua" read as printed, with the accent on "qua" not certain. The drop capital "S" of "Sententia" is written as one word. Theses 1 to 3 are run-in within the paragraph, as printed. Heading "35" is set as part of the title line. Running head and page number as printed.
